data.description: Refine the reviewed compact Home hero based on operator feedback: enlarge the geometry at phone widths without decoupling canvas/labels/hit targets, confirm the blurb uses the canonical body font token and correct any drift, vertically center the Explore Our Story arrow with its label, and slightly increase compact background overscan to eliminate the exposed top stripe while retaining the ground-line crop. Preserve expanded desktop composition and responsiveness. Validate across phone/tablet/desktop plus fresh native Android, then create an organized Paper file containing labeled homepage screenshots for major small/medium/large iPhone and Android, tablet, and desktop views.
data.title: Polish compact hero and document viewport set

data.body: Operator sequencing update: do not start the Paper viewport board until the hero edits are implemented, validated, and reviewed with the operator. Complete code/native validation first; Paper remains a later gated phase requiring explicit approval.

Implementation complete: phone-only Three root scale 1.08; canonical Inter-400 .text-body preserved and asserted; Story CTA arrow bounce removed with <=1px center contract; compact background translateY(6%) scale(1.10) block coverage with 3-5% top and 5-7% bottom overscan; desktop unchanged. Validation: typecheck PASS; unit 160/160 PASS; conformance PASS; build PASS; compact + expanded visual evidence PASS; focused Hero 33 pass/30 skip plus known touch injection miss that passed 3/3 isolated; full serialized three-engine matrix exercised 528 positions (245 pass, 275 intentional skips, 8 long-run resource/injection failures after 1.4h), with affected Firefox profiles passing 16/16 fresh and Chromium touch passing 3/3 fresh; WebKit clean. Paper/gallery/native remain intentionally paused and root-owned per operator sequencing.

Native S24 visual inspection found the source artwork's rectangular top border still visible as a stripe. The border sits ~4.5% below the bitmap top, while scale(1.10) yields only ~4% top overscan. Implementation-level rework: increase compact scale to ~1.12 and update top-overscan contracts/snapshots so the source border is fully cropped; preserve translateY(6%), bottom ground-line crop, and lg rule.

Review-cycle rework complete: compact background scale raised 1.10 -> 1.12 while retaining translateY(6%), 72% bottom object-position/origin, and byte-unchanged lg treatment. Computed top/bottom overscan now ~6% (contracts 5-7%); refreshed 320x568 and 640x360 Home evidence shows the source-art top stripe removed with ground/skyline composition retained. Validation: focused composition 16/16 PASS; representative Chromium/Firefox/WebKit phone+tablet crop checks 6/6 PASS; visual evidence 4 PASS/4 intentional skips; typecheck PASS; unit 160/160 PASS; conformance PASS; build PASS. Geometry/type/CTA unchanged; Paper/gallery/native rerun remain root-owned.

Independent code-phase review PASS; no implementation-level or plan-level rework needed. Reviewed commits 435b57c and 8dde275 against the FRAC-24 plan and DESIGN.md. The phone-only media query selects sceneScale 1.08 below 768px and passes it once to FractalObject's root Three group, so visible meshes, hit meshes, and Drei Html labels remain coupled; data-scene-scale and projected-anchor/safe-zone contracts cover the 768px boundary. At 768px and above scale is 1. The Story blurb retains canonical .text-body and computes to Inter, weight 400, normal case. The CTA remains a single inline-flex/items-center 44px target; the label and static ArrowDown centers are constrained to <=1px and the prior bounce animation is absent. Compact background keeps 72% bottom position/origin and translateY(6%), is block-level, and now uses scale(1.12), producing about 6% top and bottom overscan; inspected phone baselines and fresh S24/tablet images show the source top stripe removed with the lower ground artwork retained. The >=1024 background transform remains translate(2.75%,-8%) scale(1.35); boundary and desktop baselines pass. Fresh reviewer validation: typecheck PASS; Vitest 160/160 PASS; conformance PASS; build PASS; serialized focused Chromium hero/visual lane 38 PASS, 34 intentional skips, 0 failures; representative Firefox/WebKit phone, tablet, 1024 boundary, and desktop composition contracts 8/8 PASS; git diff --check PASS. Fresh cold-boot native S24 evidence at test-results/mobile-simulators/2026-07-24T17-37-07-845Z/android-emulator-s24-class passed with toolbar heights 762->818->762, portrait/landscape, menu, Story CTA, WebGL drag and node tap, zero failed records/fatal logs/health violations. Fresh cold-boot Android tablet evidence at test-results/mobile-simulators/2026-07-24T17-39-08-518Z/android-emulator-tablet passed with toolbar heights 1128->1224->1128, portrait/landscape and zero failed records/fatal logs/health violations. Paper viewport board is explicitly paused by the operator and was not created; code-phase visual approval is required before that separate deliverable proceeds.
Need: operator visual approval of the reviewed hero edits before resuming the explicitly paused Paper viewport board; no Paper file has been created.
